text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft watched the Shuka Sho. Seeing 
Sweep Tosho emerge victorious filled her 
with belief in the boundless potential of 
Tiara Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho had once stated in an 
interview that she would prove Tiara 
Umamusume are strong too. In this race, 
she demonstrated that strength for all to 
see.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Line Craft is eager to follow suit. Just 
then, Daring Heart, who had come to watch, 
declares that she'll be running in the 
Hanshin JF as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart is an Umamusume who came to 
Japan alone with the strong determination 
to win the Triple Tiara. She also hails 
from a premier racing club.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She was sure to be strong... Even so, 
Rhein Kraft threw herself into training, 
determined not to be outdone.
